name: Tahoua

queries.query: Tahoua Niger cadastral parcel map official cadastre land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Niger's Direction Générale des Impôts (DGI) land/cadastre mandate and an official DGI communiqué about a Conservation Foncière et des Hypothèques office in Tahoua. No public anonymous Tahoua parcel viewer, API, schema, CRS, or geometry response was found.

queries.query: Tahoua Niger cadastre carte parcellaire registre foncier officiel
queries.result: La recherche en français a retrouvé le communiqué officiel de la DGI annonçant un bureau de la Conservation Foncière et des Hypothèques à Tahoua, ainsi que le plan stratégique de la DGI. Les sources décrivent la tutelle cadastrale et foncière, mais aucun service public anonyme de géométrie parcellaire n'a été vérifié.

officialSources.observation: Official DGI communiqué found by discovery search; its title and indexed result state that Conservation Foncière et des Hypothèques offices opened in Maradi, Tahoua and Zinder from 2019-08-28. The direct GET timed out during this pass, so no additional page content was copied.

Official DGI strategic plan states that DGI implements government policy for fiscal, state-domain, cadastral and land matters and administers cadastre and land-conservation services. It also describes obsolete cadastral maps, incomplete land books, non-digitized cadastral plans, and a modernization program focused on Niamey; it does not provide Tahoua parcel geometry.

UN-hosted national geospatial information authority page identifies Niger's Institut Géographique National under the Ministry of Urbanism and Housing and exposes administrative-boundary datasets only; it is not evidence of a Tahoua cadastral parcel service.
